summary: Executable audit for the rev0124 evidence-lane hardening: public trace promotion requires a model.safetensors SHA-256 proof and the capture wrapper remains local-files-only; downloads belong to snapshot preparation, not evidence capture.

online_source_basis.fact: snapshot_download materializes a local snapshot of repository files at a requested revision.
Offline Transformers use requires files to be downloaded/cached ahead of time.
Safetensors metadata is parseable without tensor loading, but byte authenticity still requires digest checking.
